stories.title: Audit Log Schema and Append-Only Contract
stories.description: Refine and formalize the audit log schema aligned to debug_logger structure, including timestamp, actor, action_type, tool_name, input/output metadata, payload_hash, previous_hash, outcome, error_flag, and correlation_id. Enforce append-only semantics via MongoDB insert-only usage and prohibit update/delete operations at the repository layer.

stories.title: Core Append-Only Audit Logging Engine with Hash Chaining
stories.description: Extend debug_logger to implement a centralized audit logging engine that records all events with deterministic hash chaining (previous_hash → current_hash). Ensure atomic writes, automatic timestamping, correlation_id propagation, and tamper-evident record construction.

stories.title: Tool Router and Domain Service Audit Integration
stories.description: Instrument tool_router and high-risk domain services (safety_service, provider_search_service, clinical_trials_service) to emit structured audit events for every tool invocation, external API call, and safety trigger. Ensure consistent correlation_id threading across the full request lifecycle.

stories.title: Audit Log Read-Only Access Interface
stories.description: Implement an internal read-only query interface over the audit log collection supporting lookup by correlation_id, time window, and action_type. Enforce strict read-only access and include optional hash-chain verification on retrieval for integrity checks.
stories.evidence: GAP: debug_logger supports writes only; no read/query interface exists

stories.title: Audit Logging Test Suite with Integrity and Tamper Detection
stories.description: Enhance existing debug_logger tests to validate append-only enforcement, full event coverage across tool flows, hash chain continuity, and detection of tampering scenarios (missing/altered records). Include integration tests spanning tool_router to persistence.
